name: EZ Bar Reverse-Grip Bent-Over Row
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hold the EZ bar with an underhand grip and hinge at the hips with knees slightly bent.
Let the EZ bar hang straight down at arm's length beneath your shoulders.
Pull the bar toward your lower abdomen by driving your elbows close to your ribs and squeezing your lats and upper back.
Lower the bar smoothly back to full arm extension while holding your torso angle steady.
tips: Keep your lower back neutral and avoid jerking your torso upright to finish each repetition.
Pull the bar toward your belly button rather than high toward your chest to emphasize your lats.
